description: Repository-side coverage plan for representative rebuild, performance, data, recovery, resilience, capacity, and release exercises. It is not execution evidence.
globalAbortConditions: The target cannot be proven isolated from production traffic and production data.
The named abort authority or approved change record is unavailable.
A writer fence, privacy invariant, legal hold, or erasure invariant cannot be proven.
A credential, endpoint secret, access token, user content, or moderation evidence enters a general artifact.
An SLO burn, resource ceiling, integrity mismatch, or unbounded recovery estimate crosses its approved threshold.

exercises.objective: Rebuild the current projection into isolated staging from a fixed authority boundary, catch up current deltas, and prove convergence under duplicate, stale, gap, and crash/replay cases.

requiredMetrics.name: rebuild.duration
requiredMetrics.rationale: The recorded projection rebuild RTO is four hours.

requiredMetrics.name: rebuild.integrity-mismatches
requiredMetrics.rationale: Counts, versions, hashes, and invariants must converge exactly unless an approved tolerance says otherwise.

requiredMetrics.name: rebuild.privacy-mismatches
requiredMetrics.rationale: A rebuild must never broaden visibility or lose erasure state.

requiredMetrics.name: rebuild.backlog-recovery
requiredMetrics.rationale: Live delta backlog must recover inside thirty minutes.

abortConditions: The snapshot boundary moves or expires.
A gap cannot be reconciled from the authority source.
Any sampled authorization or erasure result differs.

exercises.objective: Run load, stress, and soak profiles against the approved operation mix and cardinality while proving the injector and dependencies retain the required headroom.

requiredMetrics.name: performance.headroom
requiredMetrics.rationale: The workload envelope requires at least thirty percent peak headroom.

requiredMetrics.name: performance.slo-gate-failures
requiredMetrics.rationale: Every route and freshness gate must satisfy the recorded SLO.

requiredMetrics.name: performance.injector-saturation
requiredMetrics.rationale: The injector must not be the limiting resource.

requiredMetrics.name: performance.unexplained-errors
requiredMetrics.rationale: Every error must be expected load shedding or have a resolved cause.

abortConditions: The injector saturates before the target load.
An error, latency, freshness, or dependency ceiling crosses the declared abort gate.

exercises.objective: Prove runtime identities cannot execute DDL while the isolated migration identity can apply the reviewed schema and cannot serve application traffic.

requiredMetrics.name: roles.runtime-ddl-successes
requiredMetrics.rationale: API, consumer, and job credentials must have no DDL authority.

requiredMetrics.name: roles.migration-ddl-successes
requiredMetrics.rationale: The scoped migration identity must be able to execute the reviewed migration.

requiredMetrics.name: roles.runtime-smoke-failures
requiredMetrics.rationale: Least privilege must still permit the current runtime contract.

requiredMetrics.name: roles.network-policy-bypasses
requiredMetrics.rationale: Only the migration execution boundary may reach DDL credentials.

abortConditions: A runtime identity executes any DDL.
The probe target is not a disposable isolated schema.

exercises.objective: Rehearse the current forward migration and reviewed recovery decision on production-shaped cardinality without introducing a runtime alternate schema path.

requiredMetrics.name: migration.pending-model-changes
requiredMetrics.rationale: The exact image and migration inventory must match.

requiredMetrics.name: migration.integrity-mismatches
requiredMetrics.rationale: Forward and recovery decisions must preserve declared invariants.

requiredMetrics.name: migration.latest-history-applied
requiredMetrics.rationale: An irreversible removal must refuse recovery before DDL and remain recorded as applied.

requiredMetrics.name: migration.duration
requiredMetrics.rationale: The exercise must remain within the service recovery objective unless a stricter approved gate applies.

abortConditions: A destructive recovery action is not separately approved.
Metadata lock, copy time, storage, replica lag, or invariant drift crosses its gate.

exercises.objective: Exercise the forecast-selected partition, archive, or compaction mechanism and prove replica consistency before any correctness-sensitive read routing.

requiredMetrics.name: storage.free-headroom
requiredMetrics.rationale: Forecasted storage must retain the approved growth headroom.

requiredMetrics.name: storage.consistency-mismatches
requiredMetrics.rationale: Correctness-sensitive reads cannot tolerate replica divergence.

requiredMetrics.name: storage.replica-lag
requiredMetrics.rationale: The engineering consistency window is five seconds pending environment approval.

requiredMetrics.name: storage.query-plan-regressions
requiredMetrics.rationale: The selected storage policy must preserve bounded indexed plans.

abortConditions: Replica reads broaden visibility or return stale authorization state.
Partition or archive work exceeds its storage, lock, or replication budget.

exercises.objective: Exercise duplicate delivery, broker and Redis outage, deadlock, and SIGTERM behavior under representative load with bounded recovery.

requiredMetrics.name: resilience.duplicate-business-effects
requiredMetrics.rationale: At-least-once delivery must still produce one business effect.

requiredMetrics.name: resilience.unreconciled-messages
requiredMetrics.rationale: Outbox, inbox, and error state must reconcile after recovery.

requiredMetrics.name: resilience.backlog-recovery
requiredMetrics.rationale: Broker and worker backlog must recover inside thirty minutes.

requiredMetrics.name: resilience.sigterm-lost-commits
requiredMetrics.rationale: Graceful drain must not lose committed work.

abortConditions: A fault causes unbounded retry or load amplification.
A privacy or one-business-effect invariant fails.

exercises.objective: Restart and fail over the representative MariaDB writer while proving one writable primary, bounded RPO/RTO, and complete reconciliation.

requiredMetrics.name: database.concurrent-writers
requiredMetrics.rationale: Failover must never create split brain.

requiredMetrics.name: database.rpo
requiredMetrics.rationale: The service database RPO is five minutes.

requiredMetrics.name: database.rto
requiredMetrics.rationale: The service database RTO is thirty minutes.

requiredMetrics.name: database.integrity-mismatches
requiredMetrics.rationale: Domain, privacy, and messaging state must reconcile.

abortConditions: More than one writer accepts commits.
The approved recovery point or integrity boundary cannot be proven.

exercises.objective: Restore an encrypted backup and transaction-log chain to an isolated target, verify the selected point, and exercise current-contract canary recovery.

requiredMetrics.name: restore.chain-integrity-failures
requiredMetrics.rationale: Every encrypted backup/log artifact must verify.

requiredMetrics.name: restore.rpo
requiredMetrics.rationale: The selected point must meet the five-minute RPO.

requiredMetrics.name: restore.rto
requiredMetrics.rationale: Restore and current-contract validation must meet the thirty-minute RTO.

requiredMetrics.name: restore.integrity-mismatches
requiredMetrics.rationale: Schema, data, privacy, and messaging invariants must match the chosen point.

abortConditions: The backup chain, key access, or approved recovery point is ambiguous.
The restore target is connected to production traffic.

exercises.objective: Exercise zone loss and the approved region-loss scope, then perform a separately reviewed failback without weakening encryption or writer fencing.

requiredMetrics.name: availability.zone-slo-failures
requiredMetrics.rationale: A single-zone loss must remain within the approved availability SLO.

requiredMetrics.name: availability.region-rto
requiredMetrics.rationale: The engineering region recovery target is twenty-four hours pending topology approval.

requiredMetrics.name: availability.rpo
requiredMetrics.rationale: Recovered service data must meet its approved RPO.

requiredMetrics.name: availability.integrity-mismatches
requiredMetrics.rationale: Failback must preserve encryption, data, messaging, and privacy invariants.

abortConditions: The secondary region cannot prove encryption, residency, or least privilege.
Writer fencing or the failback recovery point becomes ambiguous.

exercises.objective: Run Feed and Interaction with empty/unavailable Redis while measuring source protection, shedding, backlog disk limits, and recovery drain.

requiredMetrics.name: cachezero.database-cpu
requiredMetrics.rationale: Cache loss must not saturate the authoritative database.

requiredMetrics.name: cachezero.pool-wait
requiredMetrics.rationale: The source pool wait safety threshold is fifty milliseconds.

requiredMetrics.name: cachezero.backlog-disk
requiredMetrics.rationale: Durable backlog storage must remain below the safety ceiling.

requiredMetrics.name: cachezero.recovery-drain
requiredMetrics.rationale: The recovery backlog must drain inside thirty minutes.

requiredMetrics.name: cachezero.shed-responses-observed
requiredMetrics.rationale: The source-capacity fault must prove that bounded overload shedding is active instead of allowing uncontrolled amplification.

requiredMetrics.name: cachezero.admissions-over-bounded-capacity
requiredMetrics.rationale: No request may be admitted above the declared safe source-capacity boundary during cache loss and backlog pressure.

abortConditions: Database CPU, pool wait, disk, or calculated drain time crosses its gate.
Cache loss changes authorization or correctness.

exercises.objective: Validate maximum-replica connection algebra, storage growth, dependency headroom, and forecast cost against observed representative peaks.

requiredMetrics.name: capacity.connection-budget-used
requiredMetrics.rationale: Fleet maximum plus reserve must remain below the dependency connection ceiling.

requiredMetrics.name: capacity.peak-headroom
requiredMetrics.rationale: Peak load must retain thirty percent headroom.

requiredMetrics.name: capacity.storage-forecast-variance
requiredMetrics.rationale: Observed storage growth must remain close enough to update or approve the forecast.

requiredMetrics.name: capacity.cost-forecast-variance
requiredMetrics.rationale: Observed representative cost must be reconciled to the approved forecast.

abortConditions: A shared dependency crosses its connection or quota reserve.
Autoscaling exceeds the declared maximum or loses its rollback path.

exercises.objective: Promote the current artifact through declared canary stages and prove automatic stop plus artifact/configuration rollback without an alternate runtime implementation.

requiredMetrics.name: canary.completed-stages
requiredMetrics.rationale: The declared one, ten, twenty-five, and full stages must be exercised.

requiredMetrics.name: canary.missed-abort-signals
requiredMetrics.rationale: Every injected gate breach must halt promotion.

requiredMetrics.name: canary.rollback-duration
requiredMetrics.rationale: The prior signed artifact/configuration must be restored within fifteen minutes.

requiredMetrics.name: canary.post-rollback-mismatches
requiredMetrics.rationale: Schema, projection, security, and business invariants must reconcile after rollback.

abortConditions: A promotion stage advances while any required gate is unknown or failing.
The prior signed artifact/configuration cannot be restored exactly.
